settings.heading: 4-Day Kitchen Installation – Payment Structure
settings.subheading: Milestone-based payments. No chaos. No delays.

settings.question: How long does the custom design process take?
settings.answer: Once you finalize your selections, our team will prepare your custom design within 3–5 business days. You’ll receive a detailed layout and 3D visualization for approval before manufacturing begins.

settings.question: Can I order samples of cabinet colors and countertops?
settings.answer: Yes, we offer free physical samples of our most popular cabinet finishes and countertop materials. You can request up to 3 samples at a time through our website.

settings.question: Do you offer professional installation services?
settings.answer: We work with a trusted network of certified installers across the country. Installation can be arranged at checkout and is available in most regions for a flat fee.

settings.question: What is your return and warranty policy?
settings.answer: All custom cabinets and countertops come with a 15-year limited warranty. Due to their customized nature, returns are not accepted unless there is a manufacturing defect, which we will replace at no cost.

settings.question: How much does a kitchen cost?
settings.answer:
Our kitchens are priced at $1,000 per cabinet, with a minimum of 7 cabinets per project.

  • Maximum base cabinet size for this pricing: 39”
  • Pantry cabinets count as two cabinets

settings.question: How are payments made?
settings.answer:
We accept the following payment methods:

  • Credit card
  • Debit card
  • ACH transfer
  • Wire transfer
  • Cashier’s check
  • Zelle
  • Personal checks
  • Financing

⚠️ Important: We strongly recommend avoiding personal checks during construction. The project will not advance to the next phase until the check has fully cleared.

settings.question: Can the project be completed in less than 4 days?
settings.answer:
Possibly. Some projects may be completed in less than four days; however, this is not guaranteed.

  • The 4-day timeline is an estimate
  • We guarantee the project will not exceed 4 business days
  • If it does, you receive a $500 discount

Business days: Monday–Friday, excluding holidays.

settings.question: When are payments due?
settings.answer:
Payment schedule is as follows:

  • $350 — Design & blueprint service (due in advance)
  • 20% — Due before scheduling your project start date (deposit)
  • 20% — After dust containment installation & demolition
  • 20% — After cabinets, knobs, handles, and pulls are installed
  • 20% — After quartz countertop & sink installation
  • 20% — After final installation and cleaning

➡️ Additional options and services are paid in advance at scheduling.

settings.question: Are you insured and bonded?
settings.answer:
Yes.

All contractors working on your project are fully insured.Bonds are obtained as required per project.

settings.question: Are permits included?
settings.answer:
Permits are not included in the base kitchen price (cabinets, countertops, sink, hardware).

However, permits are available as an optional service depending on your project’s requirements.

settings.question: Are product samples available?
settings.answer:
Yes.

Samples are delivered to your home during your on-site kitchen design and measurement appointment.

settings.question: Is financing available?
settings.answer:
Yes.

We offer financing through our lending partner FTL Finance.

👉 https://ftlfinance.com/

settings.question: What is the product warranty?
settings.answer: We provide a 5-year workmanship warranty on kitchen installation.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
All kitchen materials are custom ordered and non-returnable.

  • Manufacturing defects discovered upon delivery will be replaced at no cost

settings.question: When will I receive my blueprints?
settings.answer: Blueprints are delivered 1–3 business days after your scheduled designer site visit.

settings.question: What are your cleaning & dust protection standards?
settings.answer:
We take dust control seriously:

  • Doorways sealed with double-layer plastic zipper doors
  • Floors fully protected
  • Work area cleaned and left in broom-swept condition

settings.question: Will you move or install appliances?
settings.answer: Yes — appliance removal, disposal, and installation are available as optional services at an additional cost.

settings.question: How should I prepare for the first day?
settings.answer:
Before construction begins, please:

  • Remove all personal items from the kitchen
  • Empty existing cabinets
  • Remove appliances, furniture, wall-mounted items
  • Ensure a clear path from entryway to kitchen

settings.question: Where are materials stored before installation?
settings.answer: Cabinets and flooring may be stored inside your home prior to installation to allow proper acclimation to temperature and humidity.
